name: A Noir: The Black Book - Art and Fashion
author: Franca Sozzani
description: Franca Sozzani created this cutting-edge album as an accompaniment to the exhibition A Noir, organised on the occasion of the Milan Triennial in 1998. The theme "black" is the starting point for the presentation of a starling series of works by leading artists, fashion designers, photographers, architects and interior designers. The album includes a collection of essays and a glossary exploring the use and symbolism of black not only in art, photography and fashion, but also in literature, film and music.

name: Birds of Paradise: Plumes & Feathers in Fashion
author: June Swan
description: Feathers and plumes have always been extremely popular in the international fashion scene. They are linked to glamorous dresses and garments designed by Dior, Yves-Saint-Laurent, Chanel, Alexander McQueen and many others. This book dealswith the role of feathers and plumes in fashion of the 19th, 20th and 21st century and gives an overview of the highlights and sources of inspiration of these haute couture items. Especially the plumassiers de Paris are well-know for their expertise, but feathers and plumes are also linked to Marlene Dietrich, flapper girls and Belle Époque. Not only the most beautiful garments and accessories are shown but also the story behind their creation: the designers, producers, people who wear them.

name: Bellissima. Italy and High Fashion 1945-1968
author: Maria Luisa Frisa
description: The volume traces the history of haute couture from 1945 to 1968, from the postwar years, which saw the emergence of internationally renowned designers, to the birth of ready-to-wear in 1968. A choral narrative, a topography of the fashion system that unfolds through the cities of Turin, Milan, Venice, Florence, Rome and Naples, charting an evolving map of the history of Italian haute couture.

name: Denim Design Lab. A tribute to the beauty of vintage denim
author: Brian Robbins
description: Denim Design Lab. A tribute to the beauty of vintage denim. Denim Design Lab is a guide to all things denim. The concept includes an artfully crafted hard bound book on the history of denim fabric and jeans as well as an overview of the manufacturing process of denim fabric and jeans. Featured are rare photographs of some of the oldest vintage denim in existence to serve as inspiration, and the first published comprehensive how-to guide to help true denim aficionados in their quest to create truly unique, one of a kind works of denim art.

name: The little black dress
author: Didier Ludot
description: The little black dress, as much a 20th-century fashion phenomenon as trousers for women, has found a place in every woman's wardrobe along with her other fashion basics: T-shirt, jeans and trench coat. Since the famous "Ford" dress created by Coco Chanel, every self-respecting couturier and fashion designer has brought out their own version of the little black dress. Successively singled out by Edith Piaf - the existentialists' simbol and standard-bearer for the revival of haute couture - later a must for the ladies of the bourgeoisie, the little black dress is now ultimate in fashion for a whole new generation whose eyes are riveted on Helmut Lang, Gucci, Prada and other famous names in today's fashion.
